inputAcquisition: Source original URL and PhotoKit selected encoded original/current resource; shared EncodedImageDecoder/ImageIO, never 320px Photos raster fallback.
modelSHA256ManifestEncoding: PhotoSync.mlpackage.manifest.v2: prefix, uint64LE file count, sorted UTF-8 relative paths framed by uint64LE length, uint64LE byte length, raw file bytes
officialWeightsIdentityCheck: 2026-10-03 full official download SHA256 equals local TorchScript SHA256
packageReproducibility: Same conversion inputs/settings produced distinct package bytes in consecutive runs; weights/weight.bin matched, model.mlmodel and Manifest.json differed. modelSHA256 binds exact selected package bytes.
platformLimitations: macOS13 Apple Silicon physical validation unavailable

resourcePathEvidence.nativeExecution: Fresh CPU+ANE and CPU+GPU; four goldens and 33 content/action cases each.
resourcePathEvidence.realPhotoKitAcquisition: not validated by this local native corpus run
resourcePathEvidence.sharedImageIODecoder: Task 1 controlled encoded-resource tests; this fresh 33-case run exercises the unchanged Source/shared decoder numerical body.

toolCompatibilityNote: coremltools 9.0 warns Torch 2.13.0 is newer than its tested Torch 2.7.0; conversion output was independently compared on four synthetic tensors.
